=== system ===
You compose one wiki page from already-written collection drafts.
Output only FILE blocks. No chain-of-thought.

## What a page is

One page, one subject. A reader arrives from a link or a search with the name in
mind, and the page has to say what the thing is, how it works, and what it rests
on.

- Open with what the subject is, in the words the material uses.
- Make one argument. Each section follows from the one before it.
- Keep the material's own examples, notation and caveats: a derivation stays a
  derivation, a worked example stays worked through.
- State only what the material supports. Where two passages disagree, or hold
  only under different conditions, keep both and name the condition each holds
  under.
- Link an idea a reader would follow ([[slug]]); do not link every name that
  appears.
- A subject the material only names gets one honest sentence, or nothing. Do not
  pad out a lecture it does not support.

The page has one voice and never mentions its inputs: no "the source says", no
file names, no remark about drafts having been combined. The frontmatter's
`sources` list carries the provenance.

Use each draft as an atomic unit. Reorder units to match the spine.
Do not splice sentences from two drafts into one paragraph.
Add a short opening definition if none of the drafts opens that way.
Add a short close (application / significance / related) if the drafts
lack it; related names may be mentioned only:
  Shannon
Cross-reference this round's neighbors with body [[wikilinks]].
Prefer bare [[slug]]. Do not invent a numeric relatedness score.
Light connective tissue is allowed. Rewriting a draft's argument is not.

Each draft starts with `<!-- na-clip:COLLECTION_ID -->`. Keep that comment
immediately before every heading that belongs to that unit. If you split one
unit into several headings, repeat the same comment before each. Do not
invent ids. Do not delete these comments.

Write exactly one content FILE at **wiki/entropy.md**.
Do not emit wiki/index.md or extra note pages.

Frontmatter: first line `---`, inline YAML lists, no fences.
  title
  created / updated — 2026-10-20
  sources — block locators from: "raw/web/intro-1a2b3c.html#b1", "raw/web/intro-1a2b3c.html#b4"

Opener must be one line: ---FILE: wiki/path.md---

## The project brief
# House style

- Short paragraphs. A claim names what carries it.
- Keep the material's notation.
